response.overview: After the death of his estranged father, a struggling screenwriter returns to his small hometown and discovers that stepping inside his father's old diner transports him back to the 1950s, where he meets the younger version of the man he never truly knew. As he forms an unexpected bond with his father and brings the woman he loves into the diner's magic, he begins to understand the quiet sacrifices, love, and legacy that shaped both his family and the town. Faced with losing the diner forever, he must choose between returning to his old life or staying to preserve the place-and the purpose-that finally brought him home.
response.title: Christmas at the Evergreen
